title: One stage update
statement: Given a sequence $N$ of finite oracle Turing machines over Boolean symbols, an index $i\in\mathbb N$, and stage data $d$, the updated stage data has positive set equal to the current positive set if the $i$th machine accepts at stage $i$; otherwise it adjoins the selected witness string. Its bound is the maximum of $\text{freshLen}(i,d.\text{bound})$ and $\text{freshLen}(i,d.\text{bound})^i+i$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence of finite oracle Turing machines over Boolean symbols
